foci.correctness: whether each test can fail for the regression it names (one-shot reads feeding an assertion, mocks that only serve the expected state, test.fail and skip conditions, waits and races, ambiguous locators)
foci.dataContract: the contract with the application under test (route mocks registered before navigation, mocked payloads matching the real API, accessible names, test ids and URLs that exist in the app)
foci.security: secrets and personal data in traces, screenshots, videos, reports and CI artifacts, hardcoded credentials, committed storage state
foci.performance: suite runtime (fixed sleeps, UI login in every test, serial mode and single workers without a reason, heavy beforeEach work)
foci.errorHandling: cleanup that runs when a test fails, retries that repeat destructive steps, failures a person can diagnose from the report

highRiskSurface: tests that write to a shared or real environment, authentication setup and storage state, playwright.config retries, workers and trace settings, CI workflows that upload reports
